sample.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Yuri: “I had a pretty crazy dream last night…”

Natsuki: “Oh? What was it about, Yuri? Anything interesting?”

Yuri: “Well, it was a bit…weird, Natsuki. I dreamt that our personalities were switched around. I was acting like a tsundere, and you were acting like a yandere.”

Natsuki: (laughs) “That’s definitely… interesting. So, you were all tough on the outside and soft on the inside, huh? And I was being all obsessive and possessive. Sounds like a recipe for chaos.”

Yuri: “Yes, it was quite the experience. I found myself constantly blushing and getting flustered whenever someone approached me. It was like I couldn’t express my true feelings properly.”

Natsuki: “Hahaha! That’s exactly how I feel most of the time!”

Yuri: “Really? I didn’t realize you felt that way, Natsuki.”

Natsuki: “Well, I might not show it as much, but deep down, I can get pretty embarrassed or flustered too. But it’s still hard to imagine myself being a yandere. I would probably scare everyone away.”

Yuri: “I can understand that, considering how kind and sweet you normally are. But in the dream, you were so…possessive. It was a sight to behold. You even had a knife collection and everything! All the while, I was the one with a sweet tooth!”

Natsuki: “Hahaha! I can’t even imagine myself collecting knives. But it does sound kinda cool. And you with a sweet tooth, huh? It’s a strange world we dreamt up.”

Yuri: “Indeed, it was surreal. But I must admit, being a tsundere had its charms. I felt a sense of confidence and assertiveness that I normally lack.”

Natsuki: “Yeah, being a bit of a tough cookie can be empowering. I bet you were all teasing and sassy with everyone.”

Yuri: “Well, I tried my best, but I don’t think I was very convincing. I felt so out of my element. And it didn’t help that I couldn’t express my genuine emotions properly.”

Natsuki: “Aw, Yuri, I’m sure you would’ve looked cute acting tsundere. Maybe we should try role-playing our dream personas sometime, just for fun.”

Sayori: (joining in on the conversation) “What are you two talking about?”

Yuri: “Oh, Sayori! We were just talking about a crazy dream I had last night. In the dream, our personalities were switched around. I was acting like a tsundere, and Natsuki was acting like a yandere.”

Natsuki: “Yeah, it was really weird, Sayori. Yuri was all tough and sassy, and I was all obsessed and possessive.”

Sayori: (giggles) “That sounds like a silly dream! I can’t imagine you two being like that. But what about me? What was my personality in your dream, Yuri?”

Yuri: “Ah, Sayori! In the dream, you were a lot like a dandere, acting all shy unless MC was around.”
sample.chosen:
Sayori: (blushing) “Really? A dandere version of me? That’s actually kind of cute. I guess I would be really nervous around MC and have a hard time expressing my feelings.”

Natsuki: “Hahaha! I can just picture it. Sayori, the shy and awkward one, trying to act cool around MC. It would be quite the sight.”

Yuri: “Yeah, it would definitely be a change from the usual Sayori we know. But I think it would be fun to explore these different personalities, even if it’s just in our dreams.”

Sayori: “Well, if you two are going to role-play your dream personas, I guess I could join in too. It might be interesting to see how we all act outside of our normal selves.”

Natsuki: “Absolutely! It’ll be like a little experiment. Who knows, we might even discover some hidden talents or quirks about ourselves.”

Yuri: “Exactly! And who knows, maybe we’ll learn something new about each other in the process. So, when should we start our role-playing adventure?”

Natsuki: “How about this weekend? We can all meet up at my place and brainstorm some ideas for our dream personas.”

Sayori: “Sounds like a plan! I’m really looking forward to seeing what kind of crazy scenarios we come up with.”

Yuri: “Me too! This is going to be so much fun. I can’t wait to see how our personalities will be transformed in our dreams.”

And so, the three friends eagerly anticipated their upcoming role-playing adventure, excited to explore the depths of their imaginations and discover new sides of themselves.

critic_rounds.analysis: 分析显示，Judge 对评分标准（Rubric）的判读存在严重偏差。Rubric 中的问题（如'Yuri是否在对话中明确描述...'）是要求模型生成的回答中包含这些情节内容。然而，Judge 在判定理由中多次提到'该部分信息仅存在于任务背景文本中，而非当前模型生成的回答里'，并因此判定所有标准均不满足（chosen: false, rejected: false）。这表明 Judge 混淆了'任务背景/输入上下文'与'模型生成内容'的边界。正确的核验逻辑应当是：检查模型生成的回答是否承接了背景设定并进行了合理的续写（即角色是否按照背景设定的梦境人格进行互动），而不是机械地要求模型复述背景中已有的每一句具体台词。Judge 将'背景已知事实'误判为'生成内容缺失'，导致无法区分两个回答在'续写质量'上的差异，从而给出了错误的零分平局结论。

method.trigger: 当评分标准的问题表述为'XX是否在对话中描述/确认/说明某事'时
method.principle: 必须严格区分'背景设定事实'与'生成续写内容'；若该事实已在任务输入（Prompt）中明确给出，则不应要求生成的回答原样复述该事实作为得分点，而应转而核验模型是否基于该设定进行了符合逻辑的后续互动或情感反应。
method.application_guide: Generator在设计此类标准时，若背景已包含关键设定（如梦境人格的具体表现），应将标准转化为'模型生成的回答中，角色是否针对该设定做出了合理的情感回应、调侃或延续性对话'，避免直接提问'是否描述了背景中已存在的细节'，以防止因模型未复述背景而误判为内容缺失。
